purpose: Three rigid parallax planes in each original painting; no per-pixel warping or page layout changes.
compositing: Original pixels are used for visible cutouts. Reconstructed foreground interiors use a matte eroded by 12 source pixels, retaining an opaque original-pixel overlap beneath moving silhouettes. The far plane's original coverage expands by 12 source pixels beneath the middle plane. Foreground coverage alone is feathered by 0.65 source pixels; artwork pixels are never blurred. This avoids complementary-alpha gaps and exposed reconstruction seams at the joins. Plane travel stays within these 12-pixel bands, because the reconstructed plates show as pale outlines when exposed. No synthetic silhouette shadows are applied: the mattes include a thin ring of surrounding background, which a shadow outlines.
